PM Modi Forms Task Force for Exam Reforms Led by Nandan Nilekani

Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced the formation of a high-powered task force to reform examinations and make them leak-proof. The task force will be led by Nandan Nilekani, co-founder of Infosys. The team includes experts from ISRO and the Intelligence Bureau. This announcement comes amid concerns over recent examination paper leaks.
